name: ComparEdge MCP Server
description: Zero-dependency MCP server providing verified SaaS pricing, alternatives, and feature comparisons for 495+ tools across 44 categories.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Full-text search across 495+ products by name, keyword, or use case.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Complete product profile: description, category, rating, pricing plans, and features.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of two products: pricing, ratings, free plan availability.

tools.name: list_category
tools.description: All tools in a category with optional sort and free-plan filter.

tools.name: get_alternatives
tools.description: Top alternatives within the same category, sorted by rating.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Complete verified pricing breakdown: all plans, highlights, and verification date.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Top-rated tools by category or overall.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All 44 supported category slugs and display names.
